title: Branch routing readiness: route and OSPF evidence
summary: Build the local routing prerequisites and verify each layer in order.
brief: A branch switch needs a routed uplink, a default route through 192.0.2.1, and local OSPF process 100 readiness for 10.0.0.0/8 in area 0. Enable IPv4 routing, configure the default route, configure OSPF with router ID 10.255.0.1, then collect route, OSPF, and neighbor evidence in that order. The simulator validates local route and OSPF state only: its neighbor output intentionally reports no peers because it has no remote routing topology.
objectives: Configure OSPF process 100 with router ID 10.255.0.1
Verify route, OSPF process, and neighbor evidence
hints: Start with the default route because remote reachability depends on a forwarding decision.
Under router ospf 100, set the router ID and assign the network to area 0.
A neighbor check is still valuable: in this local-only simulator, its empty result is expected rather than proof of a real adjacency.

process_checks.label: Checked adjacency evidence and recognized the local-only limit

checks.label: OSPF process, router ID, and area 0 network are configured
